Kerala High Court Orders New Panel on Vizhinjam Port Erosion

The Kerala High Court has ordered the formation of a new expert panel to study the erosion issues related to the Vizhinjam port project. The court specified that the panel must ensure there is no conflict of interest among its members. Separately, in a different case, the accused driver Suhail and passenger Joyal involved in a Mini Cooper crash have approached the Kerala High Court seeking bail after two individuals were reportedly involved in the incident.
